gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: As a customer, I want to browse available mobile devices, review the product details and configuration, and proceed through the purchase journey, so that I can successfully purchase a mobile device online.

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC1 – Mobile Device Listing: The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify that the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify that the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC2 – Product Details Page: The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC3 – Default Device Configuration: When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC4 – Purchase Journey: The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. The application shall prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button is interactable and initiates the next step in purchase journey

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC5 – User Authentication: If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC6 – Error Handling: The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. The application shall display appropriate messages without crashing.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC7 – Responsive Behaviour: The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes

test_case_improvements.missing_scenario: Verification of correct pricing display for default configuration
test_case_improvements.suggested_test_steps: Add step: Verify the device price is displayed and matches the expected price for the default configuration (Black/Awesome Navy, 256GB, 24-month installment). [Test Data- Expected price format: $XX.XX/month or total price]
test_case_improvements.suggested_expected_result: Device price is displayed correctly and corresponds to the default configuration selected.

test_case_improvements.missing_scenario: Verification that purchase journey is prevented until authentication is completed
test_case_improvements.suggested_test_steps: Add step: Attempt to close the popup without authenticating and verify that the purchase journey does not proceed. Verify that user remains on the PDP and cannot continue without authentication.
test_case_improvements.suggested_expected_result: Purchase journey is blocked until user completes authentication via login or sign-up.

test_case_improvements.missing_scenario: Verification that application displays appropriate message without crashing when device is unavailable
test_case_improvements.suggested_test_steps: Add step: Verify that the application remains stable and does not crash when device is unavailable. Verify that page elements remain functional and user can navigate to other devices or sections.
test_case_improvements.suggested_expected_result: Application handles device unavailability gracefully without crashing, displaying appropriate messaging and maintaining page stability.
